text.brief: In February 1997 Bill Clinton paroled the last Golden Venture passengers held in York, Pennsylvania, after nearly four years in custody.
text.record: The freighter had run aground off Queens in June 1993, and ten of its passengers drowned ([Board of Immigration Appeals, Interim Decision 3215 (Golden Venture passengers; DOJ EOIR)](https://www.justice.gov/sites/default/files/eoir/legacy/2012/08/14/3215.pdf)). Many survivors sought asylum because the Party's birth planning officials had sterilized them or their wives or had threatened to. Immigration judges split on such claims until Congress acted in 1996 ([Matter of Chang, 20 I&N Dec. 38 (BIA 1989) (Justice Department, EOIR)](https://www.justice.gov/sites/default/files/eoir/legacy/2012/08/14/3107.pdf); [Matter of J-S-, 24 I&N Dec. 520 (A.G. 2008) (Justice Department)](https://www.justice.gov/sites/default/files/eoir/legacy/2014/07/25/3611.pdf)). Section 601 of the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act defined forced abortion and sterilization as persecution on account of political opinion ([8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(42) (US Code, 2023 edition, via govinfo)](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2023-title8/html/USCODE-2023-title8-chap12-subchapI-sec1101.htm); [Matter of J-S-, 24 I&N Dec. 520 (A.G. 2008) (Justice Department)](https://www.justice.gov/sites/default/files/eoir/legacy/2014/07/25/3611.pdf)).
text.reading: The law named the Party's population program for what it was, a campaign of state force against families. The same government kept the Golden Venture passengers in jail while the courts caught up, so the defender recognized the persecution and punished its victims in the same years.
text.gapText: Application Architecture. Immigration judges applied the refugee definition case by case, and the same facts won asylum in one court and lost in the next.
text.fix: Define known patterns of state persecution in law, and release asylum seekers who pose no risk while their claims proceed.
